titulo: Carta — Coração de Vidro (ilustração da janela)
prompt: Richly painted anime-inspired storybook illustration for a dark fantasy tarot card, full-bleed vertical scene that fills the whole tall narrow image edge to edge, portrait composition with the main subject in the center and atmospheric detail rising to the top and settling at the bottom. Fine ink linework, painterly gouache shading, intricate details, whimsical but dark mood, deep indigo and violet palette with crimson accents and warm candle-gold highlights, drifting glowing motes and soft fog. World of DEVO: a survival game of borrowed time where every player wears a ticking timer on the wrist, with clocks, tarot and masks everywhere. A faceted glass heart with a tiny crimson flame beating inside, held gently in cupped pale hands, fine cracks spreading across its surface, frozen rose petals and shards of light floating around it in the dark. Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no numerals, no signature, no watermark, no logo, no card frame, no border, no ornamental frame, no panels, not a collage, not photorealistic, no 3d render.
